The [[Trekali Mountains]] were a moderately sized range located on the rugged [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sevarcos II]]. The mountains were situated between the [[Desert of Kariste]] and the [[Arienne Desert]].<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
